### <a name="ovox--compile_sans_for"></a>`ovox::compile_sans_for`

Type: Puppet Language

Aggregate all of the dns_alt_name (subject alternative names) for
the given role into a single array of strings without duplicates.

By *role*, looks up and includes a pool address if any, any
members of the appropriate load balancer class of targets (e.g.
clb_compiler targets if the *role* is 'compiler'), and any
sans found in *additional_sans_by_role*.

Ensures that an array of strings is returned. May be empty.

#### `ovox::compile_sans_for(Ovox::Roles $role, Ovox::TargetMap $target_map, Ovox::SansMap $additional_sans_by_role = {})`

Aggregate all of the dns_alt_name (subject alternative names) for
the given role into a single array of strings without duplicates.

By *role*, looks up and includes a pool address if any, any
members of the appropriate load balancer class of targets (e.g.
clb_compiler targets if the *role* is 'compiler'), and any
sans found in *additional_sans_by_role*.

Ensures that an array of strings is returned. May be empty.

Returns: `Array[String[1]]` An array of SANs strings for the role.

##### `role`

Data type: `Ovox::Roles`

The architectural role to compile sans for.

##### `target_map`

Data type: `Ovox::TargetMap`

The Ovox::TargetMap for the cluster.

##### `additional_sans_by_role`

Data type: `Ovox::SansMap`

Hash for additional sans to include keyed by role.

### <a name="ovox--derive_profile_flags"></a>`ovox::derive_profile_flags`

Type: Puppet Language

Generate a map of profile flags based on cluster TargetMap.

Intended to populate hiera data to inform key primary and ovdb roles
as to which profiles to include for this cluster.

This only addresses the simple case of uniform role classification
across the cluster. In the case of the primary, the module only
supports one node for autoconfiguration. In the case of ovdb nodes
that are not the primary, this assumes they all either have or do
not have postgres.

All other cases are ambiguous, and require manual configuration.

#### `ovox::derive_profile_flags(Ovox::TargetMap $target_map)`

Generate a map of profile flags based on cluster TargetMap.

Intended to populate hiera data to inform key primary and ovdb roles
as to which profiles to include for this cluster.

This only addresses the simple case of uniform role classification
across the cluster. In the case of the primary, the module only
supports one node for autoconfiguration. In the case of ovdb nodes
that are not the primary, this assumes they all either have or do
not have postgres.

All other cases are ambiguous, and require manual configuration.

Returns: `Hash[String,Boolean]` A Hash of profile flags to be included in cluster hiera data.

##### `target_map`

Data type: `Ovox::TargetMap`

Ovox::TargetMap instance for the cluster.

### <a name="ovox--generate_hiera_layers"></a>`ovox::generate_hiera_layers`

Type: Puppet Language

Generate a Hash of hiera configuration based on an
evaluation of the given $target_map and $base_config.

The returned hash is keyed by the absolute path to the hiera file
pointing to the hash of data to be written into the file by the
caller.

The function does not touch the file system itself.

#### `ovox::generate_hiera_layers(Ovox::TargetMap $target_map, Stdlib::AbsolutePath $hiera_cluster_dir, Struct[{
    Optional[postgres_version]    => Optional[Ovox::Postgres_version],
    Optional[additional_sans_map] => Ovox::SansMap,
  }] $base_config)`

Generate a Hash of hiera configuration based on an
evaluation of the given $target_map and $base_config.

The returned hash is keyed by the absolute path to the hiera file
pointing to the hash of data to be written into the file by the
caller.

The function does not touch the file system itself.

Returns: `Hash[Stdlib::AbsolutePath,Hash]` A Hash of hiera data hashes keyed by file path.

##### `target_map`

Data type: `Ovox::TargetMap`

Ovox::TargetMap instance for the cluster.

##### `hiera_cluster_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::AbsolutePath`

The root directory for this cluster's hiera data.

##### `base_config`

Data type:

```puppet
Struct[{
    Optional[postgres_version]    => Optional[Ovox::Postgres_version],
    Optional[additional_sans_map] => Ovox::SansMap,
  }]
```

Hash of additional configuration data needed to generate the hiera
data.

* `postgres_version` - The version of Postgresql to install on
postgres nodes.
* `additional_sans_map` - Hash of additional SANs for Puppet
dns_alt_names setting keyed by role.

### <a name="ovox--generate_target_map"></a>`ovox::generate_target_map`

Type: Puppet Language

Given the host TargetSpecs for the cluster and the boolean flag for
whether postgres is managed, returns an Ovox::TargetMap structure
with all the computed Target arrays for installation and
configuration. This structure can then be interrogated by other
functions to determine topology/architecture of the cluster.

#### `ovox::generate_target_map(Ovox::HostMap $host_map, Boolean $manage_postgres)`

Given the host TargetSpecs for the cluster and the boolean flag for
whether postgres is managed, returns an Ovox::TargetMap structure
with all the computed Target arrays for installation and
configuration. This structure can then be interrogated by other
functions to determine topology/architecture of the cluster.

Returns: `Ovox::TargetMap` An Ovox::TargetMap for the cluster.

##### `host_map`

Data type: `Ovox::HostMap`

A hash of the host TargetSpecs provided for the cluster.

##### `manage_postgres`

Data type: `Boolean`

Flag for whether PostgreSQL (if postgres_hosts are present) is
managed in the cluster or is just a host reference to an unmanaged
PostgreSQL service outside of the cluster.

### <a name="ovox--get_ovdb_address"></a>`ovox::get_ovdb_address`

Type: Puppet Language

Get the singular openvoxdb service address for the cluster.

If there is a single configured openvoxdb server in the cluster,
that address will be returned. If there are multiple openvoxdb
servers in the cluster, then the result of ovox::get_pool_address()
will be returned.

Otherwise the function returns undef.

#### `ovox::get_ovdb_address(Ovox::TargetMap $target_map)`

Get the singular openvoxdb service address for the cluster.

If there is a single configured openvoxdb server in the cluster,
that address will be returned. If there are multiple openvoxdb
servers in the cluster, then the result of ovox::get_pool_address()
will be returned.

Otherwise the function returns undef.

Returns: `Optional[String]` The hostname of the openvoxdb server that openvox-servers
should be configured to communicate with or undef.

##### `target_map`

Data type: `Ovox::TargetMap`

Ovox::TargetMap instance for the cluster.

This will either be the String given to the install plan for the
respective pool_address field, or the hostname of the first
load-balancer target in the TargetMap for the given pool.

May return `undef` if neither is defined.

### <a name="ovox--get_postgres_address"></a>`ovox::get_postgres_address`

Type: Puppet Language

Get the address to the PostgreSQL server that Openvoxdb instances
should connect to.

This function does not address complex configuration scenarios with
multiple postgres targets.

It returns the first *postgres_targets* entry.

If there are no *postgres_targets*, it will return the first
*unmanaged_postgres_hosts* entry.

It may return undef if no postgres host information is configured.

#### `ovox::get_postgres_address(Ovox::TargetMap $target_map)`

Get the address to the PostgreSQL server that Openvoxdb instances
should connect to.

This function does not address complex configuration scenarios with
multiple postgres targets.

It returns the first *postgres_targets* entry.

If there are no *postgres_targets*, it will return the first
*unmanaged_postgres_hosts* entry.

It may return undef if no postgres host information is configured.

Returns: `Optional[String]` The Postgresql service address for the cluster or undef.

##### `target_map`

Data type: `Ovox::TargetMap`

Ovox::TargetMap instance for the cluster.

### <a name="ovox--validate_architecture"></a>`ovox::validate_architecture`

Type: Puppet Language

Validate the given cluster TargetMap for architectural and role
errors and return an array of any errors found.

There are constraints to what constitutes a valid cluster based on
the plan being able to successful install, configure and test the
cluster by running the agent on all nodes.

The function returns three classes of issues:

* Warnings, which are informational but shouldn't affect the module
  workflow.
* Ambiguities, which reflect configuration problems like defining multiple
  primary are postgresql nodes. These issues prevent the module from
  automatically generating hiera configuration and require manual
  hiera data to be added before application of the catalogs can
  complete successfully.
* Errors, which reflect structural problems preventing
  classification of the given cluster nodes into discrete roles.

This function does not raise any errors itself, merely returns
information about them.

#### `ovox::validate_architecture(Ovox::TargetMap $target_map)`

Validate the given cluster TargetMap for architectural and role
errors and return an array of any errors found.

There are constraints to what constitutes a valid cluster based on
the plan being able to successful install, configure and test the
cluster by running the agent on all nodes.

The function returns three classes of issues:

* Warnings, which are informational but shouldn't affect the module
  workflow.
* Ambiguities, which reflect configuration problems like defining multiple
  primary are postgresql nodes. These issues prevent the module from
  automatically generating hiera configuration and require manual
  hiera data to be added before application of the catalogs can
  complete successfully.
* Errors, which reflect structural problems preventing
  classification of the given cluster nodes into discrete roles.

This function does not raise any errors itself, merely returns
information about them.

Returns: `Ovox::ArchErrors` An Ovox::ArchErrors structure with warnings, ambiguities and
errors for the caller.

##### `target_map`

Data type: `Ovox::TargetMap`

Ovox::TargetMap instance for the cluster.

### <a name="ovox--validate_openvox_version_parameters"></a>`ovox::validate_openvox_version_parameters`

Type: Puppet Language

Validates the given set of OpenVox install parameters and raises
an error for any problems.

If we're installing a released version, then collection will be
matched to version. If collection does not exist, an error will be
raised.

If we're installing a pre-release version, then the version
must be explicit, not 'latest', and collection is ignored.

#### `ovox::validate_openvox_version_parameters(Ovox::Openvox_install_params $params)`

Validates the given set of OpenVox install parameters and raises
an error for any problems.

If we're installing a released version, then collection will be
matched to version. If collection does not exist, an error will be
raised.

If we're installing a pre-release version, then the version
must be explicit, not 'latest', and collection is ignored.

Returns: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params` Ovox::Openvox_install_params with openvox_collection updated to
match version as necessary.

##### `params`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

The OpenVox install parameters to validate.

## Data types

### <a name="Ovox--ArchErrors"></a>`Ovox::ArchErrors`

Structure returned by the ovox::validate_architecture() function.

Keys:
- warnings: informational warnings about the architecture.
- ambituities: issues that will prevent auto-configuration.
- errors: structural problems that will halt the workflow during the
  architecture validation stage.

Alias of

```puppet
Struct[{
  warnings    => Array[String[1]],
  ambiguities => Array[String[1]],
  errors      => Array[String[1]],
}]
```

### <a name="Ovox--Architectures"></a>`Ovox::Architectures`

Enumeration of OpenVox cluster architecture types.

Alias of `Enum['tiny', 'small', 'medium', 'large', 'huge', 'custom', 'ambiguous', 'error']`

### <a name="Ovox--HostMap"></a>`Ovox::HostMap`

Structured map of TargetSpec host inputs, along with the
compiler/ovdb_pool_address hostnames if given, for the
ovox::generate_target_map() function.

These TargetSpecs are parameters of the ovox::install plan.

Alias of

```puppet
Struct[{
  primary_host          => BoltLib::TargetSpec,
  ovdb_hosts            => BoltLib::TargetSpec,
  postgres_hosts        => BoltLib::TargetSpec,
  compiler_hosts        => BoltLib::TargetSpec,
  compiler_lb_hosts     => BoltLib::TargetSpec,
  ovdb_lb_hosts         => BoltLib::TargetSpec,
  agent_hosts           => BoltLib::TargetSpec,
  compiler_pool_address => Optional[String[1]],
  ovdb_pool_address     => Optional[String[1]],
}]
```

### <a name="Ovox--LbPools"></a>`Ovox::LbPools`

Keys for the two load-balancer pools.

Alias of `Enum['compiler', 'ovdb']`

### <a name="Ovox--Openvox_collection"></a>`Ovox::Openvox_collection`

Strings identifying an openvox collection (packages associated with
a major version of OpenVox).

Alias of `Enum['openvox7', 'openvox8', 'openvox9']`

### <a name="Ovox--Openvox_install_params"></a>`Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

Parameters defining OpenVox agent version for the
ovox::install_openvox plan.

Keys:
- openvox_version: The version of OpenVox to install. If installing
  a released version, major version must match openvox_collection,
  or 'latest' to install latest version from collection.
- openvox_collection: The collection of OpenVox to install from.
  ('openvox7', 'openvox8', etc.).
- openvox_released: Whether to install released packages from
  the given openvox_collection via the system package manager,
  or to download and install a pre-release openvox_version package
  from the openvox_artifacts_url for dev testing.
- openvox_artifacts_url: The URL to the OpenVox artifacts server.
  Generally this can be skipped if the packages you are looking for
  are on the artifacts.voxpupuli.org server.

Alias of

```puppet
Struct[{
  Optional[openvox_version]       => Ovox::Openvox_version,
  Optional[openvox_collection]    => Ovox::Openvox_collection,
  Optional[openvox_released]      => Boolean,
  Optional[openvox_artifacts_url] => Optional[Stdlib::HTTPUrl],
}]
```

### <a name="Ovox--Openvox_version"></a>`Ovox::Openvox_version`

Matches an OpenVox x.y.z version, a version based off that with some
trailing text (such as x.y.z-rc1 or a git describe like
x.y.z-123-gabcdef), or the string 'latest'.

Alias of `Variant[Pattern[/^\d+(\.\d+){2}(-.+)?/], Enum['latest']]`

### <a name="Ovox--Postgres_version"></a>`Ovox::Postgres_version`

String representing a Postgresql major or major.minor version (e.g.
'14', '15.1').

Alias of `Pattern[/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/]`

### <a name="Ovox--RoleMap"></a>`Ovox::RoleMap`

This structure provides a consistent mapping of Target arrays to the
ov_role module roles that need to be applied within the cluster to
install and configure OpenVox services.

The keys are the spefic ov_role::<role_name>.

Alias of

```puppet
Struct[{
  primary     => Array[Target],
  ovdb        => Array[Target],
  postgres    => Array[Target],
  compiler    => Array[Target],
  compiler_lb => Array[Target],
  ovdb_lb     => Array[Target],
}]
```

### <a name="Ovox--Roles"></a>`Ovox::Roles`

Enumeration of established Openvox Service Infrastructure roles used
by this module and the puppet-ov_roles module.
XXX: Probably this type should move to ov_roles? Possibly only if
there would be an actual usage of it there.

Alias of `Enum['compiler', 'compiler_lb', 'ovdb', 'ovdb_lb', 'postgres', 'primary']`

### <a name="Ovox--SansMap"></a>`Ovox::SansMap`

Hash mapping roles to arrays of Subject Alternative Names for certs.

Alias of `Hash[Ovox::Roles, Array[String[1]]]`

### <a name="Ovox--TargetMap"></a>`Ovox::TargetMap`

This structure provides a consistent mapping of Target arrays
and a few hostname references for an OpenVox service cluster
as returned by the ovox::generate_target_map() function.

It allows a host of other small functions to return consistent
answers about the cluster architecture, and provides Bolt::Targets
for the rest of the plans to operate on.

Keys:
- primary_targets: An array primary host (openvox-server/ca) targets.
  This must be a single primary for auto-configuration. If more than
  one primary is specified, then the cluster's hiera data must be
  manually configured.
- ovdb_targets: An array of the openvoxdb host targets.
- ovdb_lb_targets: An array of any load-balancers for the
  openvoxdb hosts.
- postgres_targets: An array of PostgreSQL server targets for the
  openvoxdb service. This must be a single target for
  auto-configuration. If more than one postgres target is specified,
  then the cluster's hiera data must be manually configured.
- compiler_targets: An array of openvox-server compiler hosts.
- compiler_lb_targets: An array of any load-balancers for the
  compilers.
- agent_targets: An array of any additional cluster hosts that
  the openvox-agent is to be installed on. (typically used by test
  suites...)
- unmanaged_postgres_hosts: A TargetSpec of the original postgres host
  information passed into the plan if the $manage_postgres flag is
  false. Since the plan can handle either postgres managed or
  unmanaged we have the following states:

  1) neither $postgres_targets nor $unmanaged_postgres_hosts set:
  no postgres, so no ovdb, in the cluster
  2) managed $postgres_targets for ovdb in the cluster
  3) $unmanaged_postgres_hosts for ovdb to be configured against,
  that are hosted outside of the cluster and configured entirely
  separately (most likely a cloud db)

  The ovox::get_target_map() function will not return a TargetMap
  with both $postgres_targets and $unmanaged_postgres_hosts. A
  TargetMap in such a state is an error.
- compiler_pool_address: the hostname agents should use to reach
  compiler services. Calculated from compiler_lb_targets (hostname
  of first entry) if not given.
- ovdb_pool_address: the hostname openvox-servers in the cluster
  should use to reach openvoxdb if ovdb_targets is greater than one.
  Calculated from ovdb_lb_targets (hostname of first entry) if not
  given.

Alias of

```puppet
Struct[{
  primary_targets          => Array[Target],
  ovdb_targets             => Array[Target],
  ovdb_lb_targets          => Array[Target],
  postgres_targets         => Array[Target],
  compiler_targets         => Array[Target],
  compiler_lb_targets      => Array[Target],
  agent_targets            => Array[Target],
  unmanaged_postgres_hosts => BoltLib::TargetSpec,
  compiler_pool_address    => Optional[String[1]],
  ovdb_pool_address        => Optional[String[1]],
}]
```

## Plans

### <a name="ovox--install"></a>`ovox::install`

Coordinate openvox services installation and configuration on a set
of provided hosts.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `ovox::install` plan:

* [`cluster_id`](#-ovox--install--cluster_id)
* [`primary_host`](#-ovox--install--primary_host)
* [`ovdb_hosts`](#-ovox--install--ovdb_hosts)
* [`postgres_hosts`](#-ovox--install--postgres_hosts)
* [`compiler_hosts`](#-ovox--install--compiler_hosts)
* [`compiler_lb_hosts`](#-ovox--install--compiler_lb_hosts)
* [`ovdb_lb_hosts`](#-ovox--install--ovdb_lb_hosts)
* [`agent_hosts`](#-ovox--install--agent_hosts)
* [`openvox_collection`](#-ovox--install--openvox_collection)
* [`agent_ver_params`](#-ovox--install--agent_ver_params)
* [`server_ver_params`](#-ovox--install--server_ver_params)
* [`compiler_ver_params`](#-ovox--install--compiler_ver_params)
* [`ovdb_ver_params`](#-ovox--install--ovdb_ver_params)
* [`install_defaults`](#-ovox--install--install_defaults)
* [`postgres_version`](#-ovox--install--postgres_version)
* [`install_termini`](#-ovox--install--install_termini)
* [`manage_postgres`](#-ovox--install--manage_postgres)
* [`postgres_credentials`](#-ovox--install--postgres_credentials)
* [`compiler_pool_address`](#-ovox--install--compiler_pool_address)
* [`ovdb_pool_address`](#-ovox--install--ovdb_pool_address)
* [`compiler_dns_alt_names`](#-ovox--install--compiler_dns_alt_names)
* [`ovdb_dns_alt_names`](#-ovox--install--ovdb_dns_alt_names)
* [`capture_apply_reports`](#-ovox--install--capture_apply_reports)

##### <a name="-ovox--install--cluster_id"></a>`cluster_id`

Data type: `String[1]`

A unique string identifying the cluster of
OpenVox infrastructure being installed. This id is used to isolate
the generated hiera data/cluster/$cluster_id files that inform the
configuration roles used by applies.

##### <a name="-ovox--install--primary_host"></a>`primary_host`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

The primary openvox-server host and certificate
authority.

NOTE: This may be an array, but more than one host will result in
an ambiguous architecture...see the README.md and
functions/validate_architecture.pp for details of what *ambiguous*
means in this context.

##### <a name="-ovox--install--ovdb_hosts"></a>`ovdb_hosts`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

Array of openvoxdb hosts. By default, this is just
the $primary_host. If set to an empty array, no openvoxdb instance
will be installed in the cluster.

Default value: `$primary_host`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--postgres_hosts"></a>`postgres_hosts`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

Array of PostgreSQL hosts for openvoxdb.
Defaults to the $primary_host. If set to an empty array, no
Postgresql hosts will be installed in the cluster.

NOTE: More than one postgres host will be *ambiguous*...

NOTE: to use a separate postgres instance like a pre-configured
cloud instance, set postgres_hosts to the cloud instance so that
ovdbs are configured to talk to it, and set $manage_postgres to
false. See also $postgres_credentials (TODO).

Default value: `$primary_host`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--compiler_hosts"></a>`compiler_hosts`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

Array of openvox-server compiler hosts.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--compiler_lb_hosts"></a>`compiler_lb_hosts`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

Array of haproxy load-balancers for the
compiler hosts.

NOTE: More than one compiler_lb is not necessarily ambiguous, but
only the first host in the array will be used to set agent server
settings. Configuring fail over or dns for multiple load balancers
is out of scope for this module.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--ovdb_lb_hosts"></a>`ovdb_lb_hosts`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

Array of haproxy load-balancers for the ovdb
hosts. (more than one *ovdb_lb_hosts* has the same caveat as for
*compiler_lb_hosts*...)

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--agent_hosts"></a>`agent_hosts`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

Array of additional non-infrastructure agents to
provision. Note that the agent will also be installed on all of
the above server, compiler, compiler lbs, ovdb lbs, ovdb and
postgres hosts, with the possible exception of $postgres_hosts if
$manage_postgres is false, regardless of this setting.

The principal utility of adding *agent_hosts* is to validate that
catalog compilation through the compiler load balancer is
successful before plan completion.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--openvox_collection"></a>`openvox_collection`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_collection`

String determining the over arching
version group for the openvox packages. If only openvox_collection
is set, then all installed openvox packages will be the latest
available from their respective package repositories within the
given collection.

Default value: `'openvox8'`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--agent_ver_params"></a>`agent_ver_params`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

Hash of version parameters for specifying
the specific package versions, either released or unreleased for
agent installation. See the Ovox::Openvox_install_params type for
details.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--server_ver_params"></a>`server_ver_params`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

Same as agent_ver_params, but for the
openvox-server package.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--compiler_ver_params"></a>`compiler_ver_params`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

Same as agent_ver_params, but for the
compiler openvox-server packages.

Default value: `$server_ver_params`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--ovdb_ver_params"></a>`ovdb_ver_params`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

Same as agent_ver_params, but for the
openvoxdb package(s).

Default value: `$server_ver_params`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--install_defaults"></a>`install_defaults`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

Provides defaults for each of the
*_ver_params hashes, allowing, minimally, just openvox_version to
be supplied.

Default value:

```puppet
{
      'openvox_version'       => 'latest',
      'openvox_collection'    => $openvox_collection,
      'openvox_released'      => true,
    }
```

##### <a name="-ovox--install--postgres_version"></a>`postgres_version`

Data type: `Optional[Ovox::Postgres_version]`

The major or major.minor Postgresql version
string to be installed on $postgres_hosts. If not supplied, the
default version from the puppet-openvoxdb module will be used.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--install_termini"></a>`install_termini`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to install the openvoxdb-termini
package on server/compiler hosts so they can communicate with
openvoxdb instances.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--manage_postgres"></a>`manage_postgres`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to install and configure Postgresql
on the $postgres_hosts. Only set this false if $postgres_hosts is
pointing to a pre-configured Postgresql server (such as a cloud
instance) that will be handling database queries on behalf of the
cluster.

If instead the desired configuration is just a simple (*tiny*
arch) $primary_host that only has openvox-server installed, set
$ovdb_hosts and $postgres_hosts to empty arrays.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--postgres_credentials"></a>`postgres_credentials`

Data type: `Optional[Hash]`

Hash of credentials for connecting to a
pre-configured postgres host. For example, $postgres_hosts set to a
cloud instance, $manage_postgres set to false).
TODO: actual structure and wiring it up...

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--compiler_pool_address"></a>`compiler_pool_address`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

If more than one $compiler_lb_hosts is
defined, this should be set to the general host address for reaching
the pool. The default is the first entry in $compiler_lb_hosts.

If $compiler_lb_hosts is empty but $compilers is not, then
$compiler_pool_address must be set to whatever external
load-balancing or dns multicast address solution is being used to
route traffic from agents to compilers.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--ovdb_pool_address"></a>`ovdb_pool_address`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Same as compiler_pool_address, but for the
$ovdb_hosts array. This is only relevant if there is more than one
entry in $ovdb_hosts.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--compiler_dns_alt_names"></a>`compiler_dns_alt_names`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Any additional hostnames to add to
openvox-server certificates. The compiler_pool_address will be added
automatically if it exists (set or calculated from
$compiler_lb_hosts).

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--ovdb_dns_alt_names"></a>`ovdb_dns_alt_names`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String[1]]]`

Any additional hostnames to add to
openvoxdb certificates. The ovdb_pool_address will be added
automatically if it exists (set or calculated from
$ovdb_lb_hosts).

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ovox--install--capture_apply_reports"></a>`capture_apply_reports`

Data type: `Boolean`

If set to true, writes apply result
output to a module local ./reports director during the configure
stage so the reports can be reviewed for debugging.

Default value: `false`

### <a name="ovox--subplans--certs"></a>`ovox::subplans::certs`

Generate and sign openvox agent certificates for the given
targets.

This plan is idempotent.

The only side effect is that the primary openvox-server will always
be left in a running state since it must be up to receive csrs and
sign.

This plan will also ensure that the *puppetdb ssl-setup* command is
run after agent certs are generated if it is given a set of
$ovdb_targets.

Note: the openvoxdb package magically runs 'puppetdb ssl-setup' as
part of its post-install steps, but if the package has been
installed prior to puppet certs being generated (as is the case with
the ovox::subplans::install_openvox plan...), this doesn't help.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `ovox::subplans::certs` plan:

* [`primary`](#-ovox--subplans--certs--primary)
* [`targets`](#-ovox--subplans--certs--targets)
* [`ovdb_targets`](#-ovox--subplans--certs--ovdb_targets)

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--certs--primary"></a>`primary`

Data type: `Target`

The openvoxserver CA node.

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--certs--targets"></a>`targets`

Data type: `Array[Target]`

The nodes to generate and sign certs for.

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--certs--ovdb_targets"></a>`ovdb_targets`

Data type: `Array[Target]`

Any openvoxdb targets that additionally need to
run *puppetdb ssl-setup*.

Default value: `[]`

### <a name="ovox--subplans--configure"></a>`ovox::subplans::configure`

Configure all services for the cluster.

Also involves installation of services such as PostgreSQL, HAProxy
and such.

This plan basically runs through the following phases:

1. Targets are formally assigned a role
2. Hiera configuration is written for $cluster_id in the local
   ./data/cluster dir
3. Configure puppet.conf and csr_attributes.yaml on infrastructure
   nodes.
 * puppet server setting is set to the primary (principle
   openvox-server/ca node)
 * certificate extensions adds the role to the certificate to
   simplify future lookup of role per infrastructure node
4. Generate and sign infrastructure certificates
5. Each infrastructure node has the ov_role::${role} class applied
   to it, with parameter data coming from the above hiera data
6. If there are any exclusively agent targets, they get their
   puppet.conf server written to point to get_pool_address(),
   and set their caserver to the primary
7. Generate and sign agent certificates, if any
8. TODO: If $setup_infra_control_repo is true, add a static
   ovox-control control repo on the primary to continue to enforce the
   OpenVox configuration of infrastructure services
9. Validate agent runs on all nodes
   NOTE: purely for validation purposes, in medium, large and huge
   clusters that have compilers, an agent node is useful to validate
   that agents can successfully obtained catalogs from the
   compilers. All infrastructure catalogs come from the primary.
10. Ensure agent service is set according to $agent_service_running
    and $agent_service_enabled.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `ovox::subplans::configure` plan:

* [`cluster_id`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--cluster_id)
* [`target_map`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--target_map)
* [`compiler_dns_alt_names`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--compiler_dns_alt_names)
* [`ovdb_dns_alt_names`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--ovdb_dns_alt_names)
* [`postgres_version`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--postgres_version)
* [`postgres_credentials`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--postgres_credentials)
* [`setup_infra_control_repo`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--setup_infra_control_repo)
* [`agent_service_running`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--agent_service_running)
* [`agent_service_enabled`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--agent_service_enabled)
* [`hiera_data_dir`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--hiera_data_dir)
* [`capture_apply_reports`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--capture_apply_reports)
* [`reports_dir`](#-ovox--subplans--configure--reports_dir)

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--cluster_id"></a>`cluster_id`

Data type: `String[1]`

Unique String identifying the cluster of OpenVox
infrastructure being installed. Defines the local hiera data
hierarchy for the cluster under ./data/cluster/${cluster_id}.

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--target_map"></a>`target_map`

Data type: `Ovox::TargetMap`

The Ovox::TargetMap for the cluster.

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--compiler_dns_alt_names"></a>`compiler_dns_alt_names`

Data type: `Array[String[1]]`

Any additional hostnames to add to
openvox-server certificates. The compiler_pool_address will be added
automatically if it exists (set or calculated from
$compiler_lb_hosts).

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--ovdb_dns_alt_names"></a>`ovdb_dns_alt_names`

Data type: `Array[String[1]]`

Any additional hostnames to add to
openvoxdb certificates. The ovdb_pool_address will be added
automatically if it exists (set or calculated from
$ovdb_lb_hosts).

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--postgres_version"></a>`postgres_version`

Data type: `Optional[Ovox::Postgres_version]`

Overwrite the PostgreSQL version to be
installed by the postgresql module.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--postgres_credentials"></a>`postgres_credentials`

Data type: `Hash`

TODO: credential hash for configuring
openvoxdb for a separate unmanaged PostgreSQL database
(somewhere).

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--setup_infra_control_repo"></a>`setup_infra_control_repo`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to install an ovox-control
repo on the primary to manage infrastructure nodes post install.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--agent_service_running"></a>`agent_service_running`

Data type: `Boolean`

Final state of the OpenVox agent
service.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--agent_service_enabled"></a>`agent_service_enabled`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether the OpenVox agent service will
be set as enabled (start on reboot).

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--hiera_data_dir"></a>`hiera_data_dir`

Data type: `String[1]`

Without overwriting ./hiera.yaml, this must
be the module relative data/ directory. Generally this parameter
is only used internally in spec testing.

Default value: `'ovox/../data'`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--capture_apply_reports"></a>`capture_apply_reports`

Data type: `Boolean`

If set to true, writes apply result
output to a module local ./reports director during the configure
stage so the reports can be reviewed for debugging. Files are
separated by cluster_id and timestamp.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--configure--reports_dir"></a>`reports_dir`

Data type: `String[1]`

The directory to write apply result output two if
*capture_apply_reports* is set. By default this will write to a
module relative ./reports directory.

Default value: `'ovox/../reports'`

### <a name="ovox--subplans--install_component"></a>`ovox::subplans::install_component`

Installs a single openvox component on behalf of the caller.

Uses puppet-openvox_bootstrap tasks.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `ovox::subplans::install_component` plan:

* [`targets`](#-ovox--subplans--install_component--targets)
* [`package`](#-ovox--subplans--install_component--package)
* [`params`](#-ovox--subplans--install_component--params)
* [`defaults`](#-ovox--subplans--install_component--defaults)

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_component--targets"></a>`targets`

Data type: `TargetSpec`

The targets to install the component on.

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_component--package"></a>`package`

The name of the package to install.

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_component--params"></a>`params`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_component--defaults"></a>`defaults`

The default parameters for the openvox installation.

### <a name="ovox--subplans--install_openvox"></a>`ovox::subplans::install_openvox`

Install OpenVox Puppet agents and primary services on the cluster
without any attempts at configuration.

The openvox_* install parameters are passed to tasks in the
openvox_bootstrap module.

Similarly to apply_prep, targets are marked with the puppet-agent
feature, and facts are collected and added to the targets after
agent installation.

NOTE: The agent will be installed on server and db targets as well.

NOTE: The openvoxdb-termini package will be installed on all server
targets by default. Set $install_termini to false to skip this.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `ovox::subplans::install_openvox` plan:

* [`target_map`](#-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--target_map)
* [`openvox_agent_params`](#-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--openvox_agent_params)
* [`openvox_server_params`](#-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--openvox_server_params)
* [`openvox_compiler_params`](#-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--openvox_compiler_params)
* [`openvox_db_params`](#-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--openvox_db_params)
* [`install_defaults`](#-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--install_defaults)
* [`install_termini`](#-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--install_termini)
* [`version_file_path`](#-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--version_file_path)

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--target_map"></a>`target_map`

Data type: `Ovox::TargetMap`

An Ovox::TargetMap for the cluster.

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--openvox_agent_params"></a>`openvox_agent_params`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

The set of
Ovox::Openvox_install_params defining source
and version for the openvox-agent package to install on all
$targets.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--openvox_server_params"></a>`openvox_server_params`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

The install params for the
openvox-server package to install on the primary target.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--openvox_compiler_params"></a>`openvox_compiler_params`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

The install params for the
openvox_server package to be installed on compiler targets.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--openvox_db_params"></a>`openvox_db_params`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

The install params for the
openvoxdb package to install on the openvoxdb targets.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--install_defaults"></a>`install_defaults`

Data type: `Ovox::Openvox_install_params`

The default parameters to include
in each of the $openvox_*_params hashes.

Default value:

```puppet
{
      'openvox_version'       => 'latest',
      'openvox_collection'    => 'openvox8',
      'openvox_released'      => true,
    }
```

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--install_termini"></a>`install_termini`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to install the openvoxdb-termini
package on the primary and compiler targets. The openvoxdb-termini
package contains Puppet terminus classes, functions and faces for
interacting with openvoxdb and is typically used to configure
openvox-server for communicating with openvoxdb.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-ovox--subplans--install_openvox--version_file_path"></a>`version_file_path`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

Optional path to write an
openox_versions.<cluster_id>.json file containing the version map
of all installed OpenVox components. Useful for debugging in
automated pipelines. If undef (default), the file will not
be written.

Default value: `undef`
